candidate_digest.grouping: one digest occasion per board per calendar month

meaningful_activity_threshold.rule: at least 3 payments OR at least $5000.00 in the board/month bucket
meaningful_activity_threshold.basis: rounded candidate threshold informed by board/month frequency and total-amount distributions; candidate only until a second source snapshot establishes refresh deltas

candidate_digest.largest_new_payee: exact payee aggregation within the board/month bucket; no descriptive or geographic assignment
candidate_digest.example_shape: CB15 posted N new payments totaling $X this month. Largest new payee: NAME ($Y).

noise_assessment.evidence: A retained payment snapshot contains multiple payments per active board/month; a monthly board-level digest bounds delivery to at most one occasion per board/month.
noise_assessment.conclusion: Use a bounded digest candidate, never one alert per payment; do not promote the candidate until refresh deltas are available.

existing_watch_action_seam.delivery_and_diff: worker/src/alerts.mjs existing subscription digest and per-subscription diff
existing_watch_action_seam.current_board_watch: site/app/alerts.mjs communityboard watch currently maps to lens=meetings with an exact communityBoard filter
existing_watch_action_seam.missing_piece: The current money compiler replays City Record procurement notices; it does not read site/data/community_board_payment_actuals.json or maintain a payment snapshot watermark.
existing_watch_action_seam.reuse_plan: If a later retained snapshot pair earns the feature, carry an exact board identity and source watermark through the existing subscription envelope and render one monthly digest section; do not create a Community-Board-specific subscription stack.

decision.stop_reason: Stable cross-refresh payment deltas are unavailable from the single CB-MONEY-02 snapshot, so this card records measurement and a bounded candidate only.
decision.next_evidence_required: Retain a second CB-MONEY-02 snapshot with the same source boundary and compare immutable transaction_id sets before implementing replay.
